url.ai_description:
Product URLs from Naver Shopping platform.
Contains full HTTPS URLs pointing to Naver product detail pages, with no null values.

product_id.ai_description:
Product identifier used as primary key in Naver Shopping catalog.
Contains unique alphanumeric or numeric string values with no empty values.

title.ai_description:
Product title column containing item names in Korean and English.
Contains full product names with specifications, brand, and variant details, typically no empty values.

original_price.ai_description:
Original price of the product before any discounts.
Text representation of price values, typically in KRW (Korean Won), may contain null values.

final_price.ai_description:
Final price of the product after any applicable discount.
Numeric value typically in KRW (Korean Won), with no decimal places, may contain null values.

discount_rate.description: Discount percentage applied to the product
discount_rate.ai_description:
Discount percentage applied to the product's price.
Numeric values ranging from 0 to 100, representing percentage off, may contain null values.

currency.ai_description:
The currency column stores the three-letter currency code.
Values are standard ISO 4217 currency codes, with KRW being the predominant value for Naver Shopping listings.

description.description: Short description or overview of the product
description.ai_description:
Product description text containing item details.
Contains marketing text in Korean and English describing product features, benefits, and specifications, with some null values present.

images.ai_description:
Array of product image objects containing image URLs.
Each element is an object with a 'link' field pointing to product image, hosted on Naver's CDN domain.

tags.description: Tags or keywords related to the product
tags.ai_description:
Product tags or keywords for categorization and search.
Array of text strings representing relevant attributes and descriptors, may contain null values.

items.description: A single category level in the breadcrumb hierarchy

breadcrumbs.ai_description:
Product category navigation path from root to leaf.
Array of category names in hierarchical order, typically 2-5 levels deep, in Korean and/or English.

in_stock.description: Number of items available in stock
in_stock.ai_description:
Quantity of items currently in stock.
Non-negative integer values representing available inventory, may contain null values.

sold_out.description: Indicates if the product is sold out (true/false)
sold_out.ai_description:
Boolean flag indicating sold-out status of the product.
True when product is out of stock, false when available, may contain null values.

delivery_fee_type.description: Type of delivery fee (e.g., free, conditional, paid)
delivery_fee_type.ai_description:
Type of shipping fee model applied to the product.
Text values such as 'free', 'conditional', or 'paid', describing the shipping cost structure.

free_shipping_minimum.description: Minimum order amount required for free shipping
free_shipping_minimum.ai_description:
Minimum order amount required to qualify for free shipping.
Numeric value in local currency (KRW), null when free shipping is unconditional or unavailable.

arrival_guarantee.description: Indicates if fast delivery (arrival guarantee) is available
arrival_guarantee.ai_description:
Boolean flag indicating availability of Naver's arrival guarantee/fast delivery service.
True when guaranteed fast delivery is offered, false otherwise, may contain null values.

total_reviews.ai_description:
Total count of customer reviews received by the product.
Non-negative integer values, may contain null values.

average_rating.ai_description:
Average customer rating score on a 0-5 scale.
Decimal values with one decimal precision, representing aggregated customer satisfaction, may contain null values.

items.description: A single available option value for this variation type

value.description: List of possible values for the variation

variations.description: Product variations (e.g., different sizes or colors)
variations.ai_description:
Product variations stored as type-value pairs.
Each variation contains a type (Color, Size) and an array of possible values, may contain null values.

final_price.description: Seller's final price for the product

currency.description: Currency used by the seller (e.g., KRW)

seller_link.description: Link to the seller's page on Naver

sellers.description: List of sellers offering the product
sellers.ai_description:
Array of seller offers for the same product across Naver Shopping marketplace.
Each element contains seller name, final price, currency, and seller URL, representing competing offers.

type.description: Name of the product information attribute (e.g., 'Brand', 'Model', 'Origin', 'Material')

value.description: Value of the product information attribute

product_information.description: Detailed product information as type-value attribute pairs (specifications, brand, origin, etc.)
product_information.ai_description:
Product information stored as JSON array of name-value pairs.
Each record contains product attributes like brand, model, origin, material, and specifications, with null values present.

author.description: Name/username of the customer who asked the question

question_date.description: Date when the question was asked

answer.description: Answer text provided by the seller or Naver support

answer_date.description: Date when the answer was posted

q&a.description: Customer questions and answers about the product
q&a.ai_description:
Array of question-answer pairs for the product on Naver.
Contains nested objects with question title, author, dates, response status, and answer text, may be null/empty when no Q&A exists.

rating.description: Rating value given by the reviewer (typically 1-5 scale)

rating_date.description: Date when the review/rating was posted

type.description: Name of the product variant attribute purchased by the reviewer (e.g., 'Color', 'Size')

value.description: Value of the product variant attribute purchased by the reviewer (e.g., 'Red', 'Large')

product_type.description: Variant/option details of the product the reviewer purchased (e.g., the specific color and size combination)

review.description: Full text content of the customer review

items.description: URL of a single image uploaded by the reviewer

images.description: URLs of images uploaded by the reviewer in their review

items.description: URL of a single video uploaded by the reviewer

videos.description: URLs of videos uploaded by the reviewer in their review

helpful_count.description: Number of users who marked this review as helpful

top_reviews.description: Top customer reviews for the product, including rating, content, media attachments, and helpfulness votes
top_reviews.ai_description:
Array of top customer reviews on Naver Shopping.
Each review contains rating, date, reviewer name, content, product variant info, image/video URLs, and helpful vote count.

delivery_attribute_type.description: Delivery attribute type/method for the product (e.g., 'Standard', 'Express', 'NaverPay Quick Delivery')
delivery_attribute_type.ai_description:
Type of delivery attribute specifying shipping method category.
Text values representing Naver's delivery service classifications such as standard, express, or quick delivery options.

category_name.description: Category Name to which the product belongs
category_name.ai_description:
Name of the product category on Naver Shopping.
Text value representing the leaf-level category name from Naver's product taxonomy.

status_type.description: Product status type (e.g., active, inactive, sold_out)
status_type.ai_description:
Status classification of the product listing.
Text value indicating current state such as active, inactive, sold-out, or discontinued.

base_fee.description: Base fee or starting delivery/service charge for the product
base_fee.ai_description:
Base shipping or service fee charged for the product.
Text representation of the fee amount, may include currency unit, with null values when fee doesn't apply.

smartstore_represent_name.ai_description:
Representative owner name of the Naver SmartStore.
Contains personal/business names of store owners, marked as PII.

smartstore_representative_name.description: Naver SmartStore representative name (alternative naming/duplicate field)
smartstore_representative_name.ai_description:
Representative name associated with the Naver SmartStore.
Duplicate or alternative naming of smartstore_represent_name field, contains personal/business names marked as PII.

channel_represent_name.ai_description:
Representative name of the sales channel.
Contains personal/business names associated with channel representation, marked as PII.

channel_representative_name.description: Sales channel representative name (alternative naming/duplicate field)
channel_representative_name.ai_description:
Representative name of the sales channel.
Duplicate or alternative naming of channel_represent_name field, contains personal/business names marked as PII.

sync_nv_mid.description: Naver MID (Merchant ID) synchronization identifier (currently inactive field)
sync_nv_mid.ai_description:
Synchronization identifier for Naver merchant ID (MID).
Text value representing Naver's merchant identifier used for system synchronization.

naver_shopping_registration.description: Indicates whether the product is registered on Naver Shopping

naver_shopping_exposure.description: Indicates whether the product is exposed/visible on Naver Shopping

ep_info.description: EP (Electronic Product) information for Naver Shopping integration including registration and exposure status
ep_info.ai_description:
Object containing Naver Shopping EP integration metadata.
Includes 'sync_nv_mid' (merchant ID), 'naver_shopping_registration' (registration flag), and 'naver_shopping_exposure' (visibility flag), used for Naver Shopping platform integration.
